bio: A hare kit with a red lace of a tail. It just does it, whatever it is, before anyone has asked.
A winged hare with a red swoosh across its flank. It has never finished second and will not discuss it.
A hare in steel-grey fur with wings of feathers and a stripe of red. Every athlete in the Hollow Earth wears its mark.
note: Started in the boot of a car.
Pays the fastest to run in its colours.
